_note: Every multisyllabic word in the reading bank, divided into syllables. Each value is "parts|rule|types|?" -- the syllables joined by hyphens, the rule key into `rules`, the syllable types, and a trailing ? only where the division is a guess rather than settled by the pronouncing dictionary. Packed this way because the page that reads it is already large. Generated by scripts/build-syllable-splits.mjs; do not hand-edit.

rules.compound: Two small words joined. Divide between them.
rules.prefix: A prefix at the front. Divide after it.
rules.suffix: A suffix at the end. Divide before it.
rules.consonant-le: Count back three. The consonant plus le is the last syllable.
rules.V/V: Two vowels that are not a team. Divide between them.
rules.VC/CV: Two consonants in the middle. Divide between them.
rules.V/CV: One consonant in the middle and the first vowel is long. It goes with the second syllable.
rules.VC/V: One consonant in the middle and the first vowel is short. It stays with the first syllable.
rules.V/CCV: The two consonants start the second syllable together, so they are not split.
rules.VC/CCV: Three consonants in the middle. Divide after the first.
rules.VC/CCCV: Four consonants in the middle. Divide after the first.
